d:
Bihar men kisanon ko aksar kharab gunvatta aur kam ankuran kshamta vale bij milne ki shikayat rahti hai. kaee bar kisan mahange bij kharidne ke bavjud behtar utpadan se vanchit rah jate hain lekin ab bijon ki gunvatta janchne ki prakriya ko adhik satik aur bharosemand banane ki disha men bihar krishi vishvavidyalay, sabaur ke vaigyanikon ne ek bari uplabdhi hasil ki hai.
